items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then I met Andy Jacobson and I took some lessons from him.

ctx.x: Boston and I guess you were aware of the schools there, but did you have the intention...

Oh yeah, that's why I went, 'cause I wanted to study and Sabby told me he had a steady job and I said to myself, "Well, this is a chance to get to some things that I wanted to get to, like theory and harmony and sight singing," and so I got into that. And then I met Andy Jacobson and I took some lessons from him. He was a first tenor saxophone soloist that I can remember. He was a tenor saxophone soloist with Sousa's band and that, you know, and I said, "My goodness." And so I got to meet the man and I took some…
Did you live there as well?
